title: Sengottai
desc: Thirumoorthy is a corrupt politician who plans to kill the prime minister as he lusts after his position. However, Sekhar, a young police officer, creates hurdles in his path.

title: Suvarilladha Chiththirangal
desc: Due to financial difficulties, a high school student and her single mother go through various trials and tribulations to earn a living and provide for their family.

title: Uzhaithu Vaazha Vendum
desc: Raja is a poor man who lives with his family that is dependent on him. However, instead of taking up their responsibility, he falls for a wealthy Sandhya and lies to her to win her attention.

title: Rakhi
desc: An ambitious and young man named Rama Krishna avenges his sister's death after her in-laws burn her alive due to their greed for dowry. Thereafter, he starts killing every man that harasses a woman.

title: Andha 7 Naatkal
desc: When Vasanthi's husband, Dr Anand, learns that she was forcefully married to him, he decides to reunite her with her lover. However, Vasanthi soon falls for him and accepts him as her husband.
